projectContext.description: voiceover-matcher-subtitle: AI-powered pipeline for matching voiceover to stock footage

userStories.title: Generate sprint stories for agents focus area
acceptanceCriteria: Read scripts/ralph/config/ralph-config.json to understand the 'agents' focus area
Read scripts/ralph/session/prompt.md for project context and architecture notes
Read scripts/ralph/state/queue.json for interview details (story outline, architecture decisions, key files)
Read CLAUDE.md for project conventions and known issues
Analyze the codebase to find 8-12 specific improvements for 'agents'
Add stories US-64-002 through US-64-012 to scripts/ralph/state/prd.json (MUST use sprint-prefixed IDs)
Each story MUST have 4-6 testable acceptance criteria
Each story MUST have a 'notes' field with: (1) tier classification, (2) exact source file paths, (3) line number ranges if removing/moving code
IMPORTANT: All generated stories MUST have passes set to false - do NOT run tests or evaluate whether they already pass
IMPORTANT: Story IDs MUST follow format US-64-NNN to be unique across sprints
Mark this story (US-64-001) as passes: true when done
userStories.notes: Planning story completed. Generated 11 stories (US-64-002 through US-64-012) covering: caption healer for format discovery, negative caption caching, healer timeout configuration, orchestrator metrics dashboard, caption circuit breaker integration, healer result caching, pattern routing coverage expansion, preflight check extensibility, healing strategy presets, cross-healer coordination events, and healing session persistence. Analysis focused on user interview context about caption fetching inefficiency and broader agent system improvements.

userStories.title: Add CaptionHealer for intelligent caption format discovery
acceptanceCriteria: Create new CaptionHealer class in src/agents/healers/caption.py extending Healer base class
Implement can_handle() to detect caption-related errors (format unavailable, no captions, yt-dlp subtitle errors)
Implement fix() that invokes yt-dlp --list-subs to discover available subtitle formats before attempting download
Add auto-generated caption fallback (--write-auto-sub) when manual captions unavailable
Register CaptionHealer in HEALER_REGISTRY in src/agents/healers/__init__.py
Add tests in tests/test_caption_healer.py verifying format discovery and fallback logic
userStories.notes: Tier 1 (New Feature). COMPLETED: Created CaptionHealer with format discovery via yt-dlp --list-subs, auto-generated caption fallback, format preference ordering (json3 > srv3 > srv2 > srv1 > vtt > ttml), and comprehensive test suite (30 tests passing). Registered in HEALER_REGISTRY and added caption patterns to PATTERN_ROUTING in fallback.py.

userStories.title: Add negative caption caching to prevent repeated failed lookups
acceptanceCriteria: Extend CaptionHealer or create CaptionNegativeCache to cache 'no captions available' results
Set configurable TTL for negative cache entries (default 1 hour) in healing config
Add cache check before attempting caption fetch in CaptionHealer.fix()
Propagate structured 'no captions' status that downstream stages can handle gracefully
Add tests verifying negative cache prevents repeated failed caption attempts
Add test verifying TTL expiration allows retry after configured interval
userStories.notes: Tier 1 (New Feature). Source files: src/agents/healers/caption.py (extend from US-64-002), src/config/sections/healing.py (add negative_cache_ttl_seconds config). Integration point: src/caption_fetcher_cache.py has existing cache patterns to follow. The negative cache prevents the ~40-second failure cycle documented in user interview from repeating for same video ID.

userStories.title: Add configurable healer timeout and retry limits per healer type
acceptanceCriteria: Add per-healer timeout configuration to HealingStrategy dataclass in src/agents/strategy.py
Add healer_timeouts: Dict[str, float] field with default timeouts per healer name
Modify HealingOrchestrator._try_healer() to respect per-healer timeout from strategy
Add per-healer max_attempts configuration separate from global max_attempts_per_stage
Add tests verifying healer-specific timeout is enforced
Add test verifying default timeout used when healer not in healer_timeouts dict
userStories.notes: Tier 2 (Enhancement). Source files: src/agents/strategy.py (lines 30-88, HealingStrategy dataclass), src/agents/orchestrator.py (lines 750-783, _try_healer method). Different healers have different runtime characteristics - API healer may need longer timeout for rate limit waits, while disk healer should fail fast.

userStories.notes: Tier 2 (Enhancement). Source files: src/agents/orchestrator.py (add after line ~1055, print_report method), src/agents/strategy.py (HealingMetrics dataclass at lines 170-218). The existing print_report shows rate limiting metrics but lacks healer-specific utilization data.

userStories.title: Integrate caption fetcher with circuit breaker pattern
acceptanceCriteria: Create CaptionCircuitBreaker class in src/agents/healers/caption.py or src/caption/ using circuit breaker pattern
Configure trip threshold for consecutive caption failures (default: 5 failures)
Configure reset timeout after circuit trips (default: 60 seconds)
Wire circuit breaker into caption fetcher error handling path
Add circuit breaker state to orchestrator metrics for monitoring
Add tests for circuit breaker trip, reset, and half-open states
userStories.notes: Tier 2 (Enhancement). Source files: src/agents/healers/caption.py, src/downloader/circuit_breaker.py (existing pattern to follow at lines 1-150). The user interview shows repeated caption failures for same video - circuit breaker prevents hammering YouTube API when captions genuinely unavailable.

userStories.title: Add healer result caching for idempotent healing actions
acceptanceCriteria: Add HealerResultCache class to cache successful healing actions
Cache key based on error signature (type + message hash + stage)
Skip redundant healing attempts if identical error was recently healed
Add configurable cache TTL (default: 5 minutes)
Add cache invalidation when config changes (via config_modified flag)
Add tests verifying cache hit prevents redundant heal attempts
userStories.notes: Tier 2 (Enhancement). Source files: src/agents/orchestrator.py (integrate at lines 618-678, coordinate_heal method), new src/agents/healer_cache.py. The orchestrator tracks recent_errors (line 851-879) but only for loop detection, not for caching successful resolutions.

userStories.title: Expand pattern routing coverage for common error categories
acceptanceCriteria: Add caption-specific patterns to PATTERN_ROUTING in src/agents/fallback.py
Include patterns for: 'no subtitles', 'caption unavailable', 'format not available' (subtitle context)
Add patterns for embedding-related errors (numpy shape mismatch, empty array)
Add patterns for LLM provider errors (gemini quota, anthropic overloaded)
Update pattern_route() tests to cover new patterns
Verify no false positive matches with existing test cases
userStories.notes: Tier 2 (Enhancement). Source files: src/agents/fallback.py (PATTERN_ROUTING dict at lines 31-64). Current patterns don't cover caption-specific errors from user interview ('Requested format is not available' for subtitles). Also missing embedding/numpy errors and LLM provider-specific errors.

userStories.title: Add preflight check extensibility for custom validators
acceptanceCriteria: Add register_preflight_check() method to HealingOrchestrator

userStories.notes: Tier 3 (Extensibility). Source files: src/agents/orchestrator.py (run_preflight at lines 233-303). Current preflight checks are hardcoded; this allows pipeline stages or external code to register domain-specific validation without modifying orchestrator source.
